hero.kicker: Follow the light · or be forgotten
hero.description: A band of adventurers awakens at the heart of a circle of light, with barely any gear and no idea where they are. Beyond the light, monsters pour out by the thousands, without end. Follow the circle, carve your way through the horde and grow stronger with every fallen foe. How long can you survive?
hero.video_fallback: Your browser does not support video playback.

features.title: Follow the light. Hold back the night. Grow stronger.

circle.name: The Circle
circle.description: The light is your only shelter, and it never stays still. Follow the circle across an unknown land: beyond its edge, only darkness awaits.

horde.name: The Horde
horde.description: Beyond the light, monsters emerge by the thousands, relentlessly. Each wave is larger and deadlier than the last.

ascent.name: The Ascent
ascent.description: You set out with almost nothing. As your enemies fall, your power grows: new weapons, new abilities, until you become the storm yourself.

vigil.name: The Vigil
vigil.description: There is no victory, only survival. How long will you last in this hostile land? Every minute stolen from the night counts.

support.title: How do you stay in the light?

requirements.question: What do I need to play?
requirements.answer: An up-to-date browser (Chrome, Firefox or Edge) and a stable internet connection. The game runs right in your browser, nothing to install.

lag.question: My game stutters or desyncs.
lag.answer: This is usually caused by an unstable connection or an overloaded browser. Close unused tabs, check your connection, then restart the game.

circle.question: Why do I have to follow the circle?
circle.answer: The circle of light is your only shelter, and it never stops moving. Beyond it, you are at the mercy of the darkness: stay close to the light and follow it.

power.question: How do I get stronger?
power.answer: By cutting down enemies. Every monster you defeat makes you progress and lets you upgrade your weapons and abilities as the run goes on.

win.question: Can you win?
win.answer: No: there is no ending, only survival. The goal is to hold out against the horde for as long as possible.

block.question: How do I block another player?
block.answer: From their profile, use the block button. You can find blocked players, and unblock them, on the Friends page, under the "Blocked Users" tab.

lore.title: At the heart of the circle, one rule: hold on.
lore.intro: No one remembers arriving here. There is the light, there is the group, and all around, the night crawling with life. Here is what we know.

awakening.label: THE AWAKENING
awakening.title: They don't know how they got here.
awakening.body: A band of adventurers opens their eyes at the center of a circle of light. A few makeshift weapons, almost no gear, and no memory of the road that led them there. Around them stretches a land none of them recognizes.

circle.label: THE CIRCLE
circle.title: The light does not wait for them.
circle.body: The circle is the only place where one can still breathe, and it never stays still. It drifts slowly across this unknown world, and the adventurers have no choice but to follow it, step after step, never knowing where it leads.

horde.label: THE HORDE
horde.title: Beyond the light, there are thousands of them.
horde.body: Monsters pour out of the darkness, endlessly and relentlessly. The longer it lasts, the more numerous and dangerous they become. No one knows where they come from; all anyone knows is that they will not stop.

keepers.label: THE LIGHT KEEPERS
keepers.title: Every enemy felled makes them stronger.
keepers.body: Those who survive do not stay the same. As their enemies fall, the adventurers grow in power, until they can stand against waves that would have swept them away minutes earlier. One question remains: how long will they last?

data.title: Personal data
data.body: When you sign up, we collect your email address, username, first and last name, date of birth, and the profile information you choose to provide (display name, bio, gender…). This data is used solely to operate the service: it is never sold or used for commercial purposes. In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, object to and erase your data, which you can exercise by contacting the team.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The site only uses technical cookies that are essential to its operation: authentication tokens to keep you signed in, and remembering your chosen language. Your display theme is kept in your browser's local storage. No advertising or analytics cookies are set.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any question about the site or your data, visit the <support>help center</support> or reach the team through its <github>GitHub organization</github>.

wiki.title: Arsenal & Tome Compendium
wiki.subtitle: Comprehensive guide to combat mechanics, stats scaling, weapons, and optimal tome synergies.

notes.title: Core Rules & Combat Notes
notes.affinity: Affinity determines stat scaling: 1.0 is 100% effectiveness, 0.5 is half, and >1.0 amplifies the stat.
notes.global: Tomes grant global bonuses to player stats or scaling across all equipped weapons simultaneously.
notes.limits: You can carry a maximum of 4 Tomes (max level 99 per tome). Weapon attack rates are subject to max caps.
notes.weaponsLimit: You can carry a maximum of 3 weapons at the same time during a run.

attackDamage.desc: Base value is 100 (100%). Multiplies base attack output per hit across all carried weapons modified by affinity.
attackDamage.formula: Final Damage = Base Damage × (1 + Stat Bonus × Affinity)

attackSpeed.desc: Base value is 1.0. Increases attack frequency and lowers tick intervals between attacks.

range.desc: Base value is 8. Extends projectile travel distance, target acquisition radii, and throwing reach.

size.desc: Base value is 1.0. Increases physical collision hitboxes, slash arcs, and aura radius of weapons.
size.formula: Hitbox Scale = Base Size × Size Multiplier

duration.desc: Base value is 1.0. Keeps active spell effects, slash arcs, and spinning axes alive on the battlefield longer.
duration.formula: Applies at 100% scaling with no affinity penalty

quantity.desc: Base value is 0. Adds extra physical projectiles per volley cast.

penetration.desc: Base value is 0. Allows projectiles to pierce through targets without disappearing on impact.
penetration.formula: Only upgraded through Staff and Bow perks

moveSpeed.desc: Base value is 30. Direct movement speed modifier to outrun hordes and maintain spatial positioning.

maxHealth.desc: Base value is 100. Raises maximum health pool while dynamically rescaling current health percentage.
maxHealth.formula: Current HP% is preserved upon upgrade

armor.desc: Base value is 1. Direct damage reduction against all incoming monster attacks.

lifesteal.desc: Base value is 1 (1%). Converts actual damage dealt into immediate player healing.

luck.desc: Base value is 1.0. Multiplies weight rolls for Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary upgrade choices.
luck.formula: Weights = Base Weight × Luck (Common stays fixed)

combatRules.title: Combat Pipeline & System Mechanics
combatRules.affinityDesc: A weapon affinity of 1.0 applies a stat bonus at standard value. An affinity of 0.5 reduces efficiency by half, while 1.25 amplifies the bonus strength by 25%.
combatRules.armorDesc: Armor uses a hyperbolic formula, meaning every point guarantees effective health scaling without granting total invincibility.
combatRules.tomeLimitDesc: You can select up to 4 Tomes per run (capped at level 99 each). Once all 4 slots are occupied, drafting will only offer copies of held tomes.

axeSize.title: Axe + Tome of Growth (Size Multiplier)
axeSize.description: The Axe possesses a unique 1.25x affinity for Size. Equipping the Tome of Growth expands its spinning contact cylinder significantly more than standard weapons, turning planted axes into massive stationary blender zones.

staffRange.title: Staff + Tome of Quantity & Range
staffRange.description: The Staff has long acquisition range (1.25x affinity) but low fire rate. Pairing it with Tome of Quantity and Tome of Range transforms single-target homing fireballs into long-distance homing swarms.

bowHaste.title: Bow + Tome of Haste (Attack Speed)
bowHaste.description: With a 1.2x Attack Speed affinity, the Bow scales rapidly with Tome of Haste, firing dense streams of arrows capable of holding off incoming hordes.

aura.name: Aura
aura.description: A permanent ring of energy centred on the player. It is never aimed and picks no target: it simply burns whatever comes close.
aura.behavior: On every tick the ring is swept as a cylinder around the player, damaging all enemies inside without projectiles or cooldown per target.
aura.bestFor: Close-quarters swarm control, AFK/low-effort mob clearing, and providing a defensive perimeter against fast runners.
aura.synergyTip: Scales best with Size and Attack Speed to expand the burning zone and increase tick frequency.

effects.attackDamage: Raises the damage dealt on each tick.
effects.attackSpeed: Raises how often the ring ticks.
effects.range: Widens the radius of the ring.
effects.size: Widens the radius of the ring, on top of range.

sword.name: Sword
sword.description: A melee blade swung in front of the player. It hits hard in a wide arc, but only reaches what stands ahead.
sword.behavior: Slashes a 180-degree arc forward, damaging and knocking back enemies. Does not travel.
sword.bestFor: Frontal burst defense, pushing through dense enemy walls, and directional crowd control.
sword.synergyTip: Combines high base damage with Duration and Size to keep the knockback zone active longer.

effects.attackDamage: Raises the damage of each slash.
effects.attackSpeed: Raises how often the slash triggers.
effects.range: Extends the reach of the arc.
effects.size: Extends the reach of the arc, on top of the range stat.
effects.duration: Keeps the slash effect alive longer.

axe.name: Axe
axe.description: A thrown axe that plants itself in the ground and keeps spinning. An area control weapon rather than a burst one.
axe.behavior: Flies to the nearest enemy within range, then spins in place for its duration, damaging everything within its cylinder.
axe.bestFor: Choke-point defense, stationary boss damage, and zone denial.
axe.synergyTip: Massive 1.25x Size affinity makes Tome of Growth expand its spinning radius exponentially.

effects.attackDamage: Raises the damage of each contact.
effects.attackSpeed: Raises how often an axe is thrown.
effects.range: Extends how far the axe can be thrown.
effects.size: Widens the contact cylinder of the spinning axe.

staff.name: Staff
staff.description: A caster weapon that launches homing fireballs. The longest reach and the highest damage per hit, but the slowest rhythm.
staff.behavior: Fires homing fireballs at the nearest target within range that track until contact, expiration, or pierce limit.
staff.bestFor: Single-target boss melting, long-range sniper plays, and high burst damage.
staff.synergyTip: Benefits immensely from Quantity and Range, turning slow single casts into homing volleys.

effects.attackDamage: Raises the damage of each fireball.
effects.attackSpeed: Raises how often a volley is cast.
effects.range: Extends the acquisition range used to pick a target.
effects.size: Widens the hit area of the fireball.
effects.duration: Lets a fireball live longer before it expires.
effects.quantity: Adds extra fireballs to the volley.
effects.penetration: Lets a fireball pass through extra monsters.

bow.name: Bow
bow.description: A ranged weapon firing a fan of arrows forward. Each arrow is weak on its own; the weapon lives on volume and rate of fire.
bow.behavior: Fires a wide spread of arrows straight ahead. Each arrow disappears on contact unless penetration is granted.
bow.bestFor: Directional horde suppression, high-rate-of-fire builds, and screen clearing with penetration upgrades.
bow.synergyTip: Leverages 1.2x Attack Speed affinity and extra Quantity to create an impenetrable arrow wall.

effects.attackDamage: Raises the damage of each arrow.
effects.attackSpeed: Raises how often a volley is fired.
effects.range: Extends how far an arrow travels before it expires.
effects.size: Widens the hit area of the arrow.
effects.duration: Lets an arrow live longer before it expires.
effects.quantity: Adds extra arrows to the spread.
effects.penetration: Lets an arrow pass through extra monsters.

damage.name: Tome of Power
damage.description: Raises the damage of every weapon the player carries.

cooldown.name: Tome of Haste
cooldown.description: Makes every weapon attack more often.

agility.name: Tome of Agility
agility.description: Makes the player move faster to outrun the horde and maintain positioning.

vitality.name: Tome of Vitality
vitality.description: Raises maximum player health and rescales current health.

armor.name: Tome of Armor
armor.description: Reduces incoming damage via standard defense formulas.

blood.name: Blood Tome
blood.description: Heals the player from a percentage of damage dealt across all weapons.

range.name: Tome of Range
range.description: Extends target acquisition distance and travel ranges for all attacks.

size.name: Tome of Growth
size.description: Enlarges attack hitboxes, arcs, and effect radii.

duration.name: Tome of Duration
duration.description: Extends the active uptime of slashes, spinning axes, and projectile lifetimes.

quantity.name: Tome of Quantity
quantity.description: Adds extra projectiles per volley to multi-projectile weapons (Staff and Bow).

fortune.name: Tome of Fortune
fortune.description: Increases luck stat to boost the drop rates of higher-rarity upgrades.
